# CCWS Documentation

> CCWS documentation helps users install ChatGPT (Codex), register a CCWS account, recharge, create an API Key, configure ChatGPT, configure CC Switch, use ChatGPT (Codex) image generation, and troubleshoot common setup or request errors.

## Canonical Sites

- Website: https://www.ccws.pro/
- Documentation: https://docs.ccws.pro/
- Support guide: https://docs.ccws.pro/guide/support

## Key Facts

- CCWS provides documentation for ChatGPT (Codex) users who need a stable OpenAI-compatible API base URL and API Key configuration.
- For ChatGPT (Codex), CC Switch, and tools that ask for an OpenAI-compatible Base URL, use `https://www.ccws.pro/v1`.
- The root service URL is `https://www.ccws.pro`.
- Users create their own API Key in the CCWS console. Do not paste real API Keys into chat windows, screenshots, public repositories, or shared documents.
- Recommended ChatGPT (Codex) setup path: install ChatGPT (the desktop app includes Codex), register or log in to CCWS, recharge the account, create an API Key, then configure ChatGPT to connect to CCWS at `https://docs.ccws.pro/guide/connect` and verify ChatGPT replies to a simple request.
- The configuration is complete when ChatGPT replies to a test message after the CCWS Provider is enabled and ChatGPT is restarted.
- The ChatGPT desktop app (which includes Codex) requires Windows 10 or later. Windows 8 users should use Codex CLI; systems earlier than Windows 8 must be upgraded before using ChatGPT (Codex).
- Recommended CC Switch provider fields: provider name `CCWS`, website `https://www.ccws.pro`, API request URL `https://www.ccws.pro/v1`, and the user's current CCWS API Key.
- Manual ChatGPT (Codex) configuration should use `base_url = "https://www.ccws.pro/v1"` in the Codex provider config and store the API Key outside project repositories.
- Do not use `https://www.ccws.pro` alone as the ChatGPT (Codex) Base URL. Do not use a full endpoint path such as `/v1/chat/completions` as the Base URL.
- CCWS Codex Image Skill uses the environment variable `CCWS_IMAGE_API_KEY`.
- The ChatGPT (Codex) image generation API Key should support `model: gpt-image-2`.
- If a request fails, check account balance, API Key validity, Base URL, model name, network connectivity, and the tool's full error log before contacting support.
- For ChatGPT (Codex) 401 errors, check API Key validity and whether ChatGPT is reading the latest CCWS Provider configuration.
- For ChatGPT (Codex) 403 errors, check account, model, package, balance, and Key permissions.
- For ChatGPT (Codex) 429 errors, reduce concurrency or request frequency, then check balance and package limits.
- For `model not found`, keep Base URL as `https://www.ccws.pro/v1` and check model name, account permission, Key permission, and whether ChatGPT has been restarted after changing Provider.
- For slow first-token responses (about 30-120 seconds, occurring consistently on every message), create a new session to test: if a new session is fast, the issue is a large context in the old session (often too many images); compress the old session and limit the number of images per session.

## Primary Documentation

- Home: https://docs.ccws.pro/
- Quick start (full task steps overview): https://docs.ccws.pro/guide/quickstart
- ChatGPT (Codex) install: https://docs.ccws.pro/guide/codex-install
- Optional Node.js and Git setup for Codex CLI users: https://docs.ccws.pro/guide/nodejs-git
- Register or log in: https://docs.ccws.pro/guide/register
- Recharge or renew: https://docs.ccws.pro/guide/recharge
- API request URL and API Key: https://docs.ccws.pro/guide/api-key
- Configure ChatGPT (Codex) to connect to CCWS (main setup page, merged from codex / codex-api-key / codex-base-url): https://docs.ccws.pro/guide/connect
- ChatGPT (Codex) Base URL (merged into connect page): https://docs.ccws.pro/guide/codex-base-url
- ChatGPT (Codex) API Key configuration (merged into connect page): https://docs.ccws.pro/guide/codex-api-key
- ChatGPT (Codex) configuration (merged into connect page): https://docs.ccws.pro/guide/codex
- CC Switch configuration: https://docs.ccws.pro/guide/config-switch
- ChatGPT (Codex) image generation: https://docs.ccws.pro/guide/codex-image

- Troubleshooting overview: https://docs.ccws.pro/troubleshooting/

- Slow first-token response: https://docs.ccws.pro/troubleshooting/slow-response

## Chinese Summary

- CCWS 文档入口：https://docs.ccws.pro/
- 快速开始（任务步骤一览）：https://docs.ccws.pro/guide/quickstart
- CCWS 官网：https://www.ccws.pro/
- ChatGPT（Codex）、CC Switch 和 OpenAI 兼容工具的 Base URL：`https://www.ccws.pro/v1`
- 主线路径：安装 ChatGPT（桌面端含 Codex）→ 注册 CCWS → 充值 → 创建 API Key → 配置 ChatGPT 连接 CCWS（https://docs.ccws.pro/guide/connect）→ 发测试消息确认配置完成。
- API Key 需要用户自己在 CCWS 控制台创建，不应在聊天窗口、截图、公开仓库或共享文档中暴露。
- ChatGPT 桌面应用（内含 Codex）最低支持 Windows 10；Windows 8 用户应使用 Codex CLI；Windows 8 以下系统需要先升级。
- ChatGPT（Codex）生图技能使用环境变量 `CCWS_IMAGE_API_KEY`，对应 Key 需要支持 `gpt-image-2`。
